title: Countries and directions — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. A country and its surroundings. Vilken goes with en nouns, vilket with ett nouns, and vilka with plurals.

s01.sentenceGloss: Which country do you come from?
s01.note: Land is an ett noun: vilket land.

s02.sentenceGloss: Which city does she live in?
s02.note: Stad is an en noun: vilken stad.

s03.note: Here språk is plural, so use vilka.

s04.sentenceGloss: Kiruna is in the north, far from Malmö.
s04.note: I norr means in the north.

s05.sentenceGloss: Malmö is in the south, near Denmark.
s05.note: I söder means in the south.

s06.sentenceGloss: Gotland is an island in the Baltic Sea.

s07.note: In a main clause inte normally follows the finite verb.

s08.note: After initial I dag the finite verb precedes the subject.
